column1: // What a #!Table cell has to look like to be a number, and the value it is; "none" means it is
// not a number. Read by InterpreterBlockUnit (the server's parseNumber, every row) and by
// test/table.number-contract.test.mjs (tablesorter's digit parser, the rows that are numbers).
// Lines starting with "//" are comments; the rest is the spelling, a tab, the value.
// A spreadsheet's spelling: thousands separators, a sign, a currency mark, a unit on the end.
// The comma is a thousands separator, never a decimal mark.
// A sign and parentheses together is text to tablesorter's digit parser, so it is text here.
// The Unicode minus is not a sign: tablesorter's digit parser drops it and would sort −3 as 3.
